data/historical/put_hedge_v1_pput.csv.used_by: Cboe PPUT index history (daily closes); the pricing-model sanity target

data/historical/put_hedge_v1_sp500tr.csv.used_by: Yahoo ^SP500TR daily closes; S&P 500 total return for the PPUT dividend leg

data/historical/put_hedge_v1_vix.csv.used_by: Yahoo ^VIX daily closes; the pre-registered fallback and the PPUT sanity input

data/historical/put_hedge_v1_vxn.csv.used_by: Yahoo ^VXN daily closes; QQQ/NDX 30-day implied vol, 2001-01-23 -> 2026-10-22

data/historical/stress_robustness_v1_dai.used_by: QQQ/SPY/QLD bars (the fast engine's main-window input)
